skill.summary: Download and transcribe YouTube videos using yt-dlp and Whisper CLI, saving audio and transcripts for playback and summary from any YouTube URL.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of kai-youtube skill.
- Watch and transcribe YouTube videos by downloading audio with yt-dlp and transcribing via Whisper CLI.
- Organizes audio and transcripts by video ID in the workspace folder.
- Supports any YouTube URL.
- Includes trigger phrases for easy activation.
